summary: Buried Treasure Issue Reporting System backend — 28/28 pytest cases PASS. Validated /api/bt/reports/can-report (no_hunt + already_reported), POST /reports validation (invalid source/category, group not found, group not hunting, non-member 403, no active solo 404), happy paths SOLO (admin self → recipients_count=0 with row still inserted; non-admin → recipients=[admin]), happy path GROUP (admin=creator dedupes recipients to 1), rate limit (409 second pending → succeeds after /ignore), /reports/pending banner feed clears on ignore, GET /reports/{rid} shape + viewed_by + 403 gating for non-recipient, /confirm inserts bt_blocked_coords (lat/lng/radius_m=30/source_report_id/added_by) and second call 400, /ignore writes no block doc and second call 400. Block-aware chest picker integration: seeded bt_blocked_coords at remote Arctic coord, ran /api/bt/solo/start centered on it 5× with 100m radius — every chest landed outside the 30 m block radius (haversine validated). Regression smoke 8/8 (/bt/settings, /schedule, /solo/current, /groups/mine, /groups/available, /friends-eligible, /invites/pending, /reports/pending, POST /location).

minor.issue: Overpass returns HTTP 406 repeatedly (3-4 retries) before falling back to random point — adds 30–60s latency on every solo start. Backend still serves the request correctly via _pick_safe_random_point fallback, but consider switching Overpass headers/server or caching to reduce p95 latency. Not blocking.

action_items: No action items — backend Issue Reporting System is fully functional. Main agent can proceed to frontend wiring with confidence.
critical_code_review_comments: Recipients are correctly deduped and the reporter is filtered (verified for admin-self-report → 0 recipients, and group-admin-creator → 1 recipient).
/confirm and /ignore use the find_one_and_update({status:'pending'}) atomic guard correctly; second call returns 400.
bt_blocked_coords row created on /confirm carries radius_m=30, source_report_id, added_by, added_at — block-aware picker honors it (validated via 5 fresh solo/start spawns).
seed_data_creation: Created 2 mongo-seeded test users (TEST_BT_RPT_U_*, TEST_BT_RPT_B_*) in users + profile collections; minted HS256 JWTs locally with JWT_SECRET. Teardown deletes both users + their bt_solo / bt_player_location / friend_requests / bt_issue_reports rows. Group test inserts TEST_BT_RPT_GRP_* docs directly into bt_groups and cleans up. Blocked-coord integration test inserts TEST_BT_BLK_* into bt_blocked_coords and removes it. Per-test autouse fixture also wipes any reports whose reporter or recipients match the TEST_BT_RPT_ prefix and any bt_blocked_coords added_by admin so the suite is order-independent.
